text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Heeellloooo, everyone~~! Today~, we big 
sisters are going to teach you all about 
traffic safety~~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It looks like those older Umamusume 
girls over there are playing tag~. Keep a 
close eye on them, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Human Girl A
text_block_list.text:
You're an older girl? You're so tiny! 
You're about the same size as me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Guh... I'm not that small!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even though Maya's aiming to be a mature 
woman... Why does Maya have to play the 
kid?! Boo boo!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I'd like to have a word about the casting 
and role selection, but... it's for the 
little ones. I'll just have to bear with 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Over here, Mr. Demon! Ehehe~ you'll never 
catch me~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-Wait up~... Ah!! Look out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Out of the waaaaay, get outta the 
waaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaa~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look out! Those two almost collided! An 
Umamusume in full stride cannot stop on a 
dime. Please make sure not to jump out in 
front of them~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl B
text_block_list.text:
"B-But Mommy said running at full speed 
outside is a no-no!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Umamusume shouldn't run full 
speed outside of designated areas. Good on 
ya for following the rules!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Do you know about the Umamusume lanes on 
the road? Umamusume run down them at full 
speed. Make sure you never jump out into 
them, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Human Boy
text_block_list.text:
So I just gotta watch out when crossing 
the Umamusume lanes, right!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, any Umamusume while running is 
dangerous! Here, just watch those ladies 
over there.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eek!?
(Boooooooom! Rumble-rumble-rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ooh~! That was a flashy roll!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...! It's all Rice's 
fault... Rice just brings misfortune...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that was the plan all along, 
right? Trainer's alive and kicking, don't 
worry."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
See? Even when we're not going all out, 
Umamusume are fast. We might not look it, 
but we're strong too. Give someone a 
shove, and even a grown adult'll go 
flyin'!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Never jump out in front of a running 
Umamusume. And Umamusume girls, always 
watch your surroundings when you run. 
Let's all make sure to follow the rules, 
okay~?"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yeeeees!!
